info.name: Schedule a data version export job

items.docs:
Schedule a data version export job. The job schedules immediately and will begin when resources are available. The response returns a `jobUuid` that you can use to check the export job status.

 **Note:** There is a limit of 10 export jobs per tenant per day.

 **Note:** <em>This API is in **alpha**. While in alpha, APIs may change in a breaking way without notice; functionality may be removed, and no deprecation notices will be issued.

info.name: Retrieve a data version export job's status

params.name: jobUuid
params.description: The unique identifier of the data version export job.

items.docs: Retrieve the status of a data version export job. After the job completes successfully, this endpoint returns an `exportUuid` that you can use to retrieve the export information and download export files. **Note:** This API is in **alpha**. While in alpha, APIs may change in a breaking way without notice; functionality may be removed, and no deprecation notices will be issued. If you are interested in using this API, please contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM).

info.name: Download a file from a data version export

params.name: exportUuid
params.description: The unique identifier of the data version export.

params.name: fileId
params.description: The unique integer identifier of the file within the data version export.

items.docs:
This API allows you to download a file from a data version export.
Data version export files are in CSV format, compressed with gzip.
